newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone troops, hunters battle for town.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone troops, hunters battle for town.

text.p: The Sierra Leone army and a militia of local hunters fought for control of the eastern town of Kenema on Sunday and bodies littered the streets, military sources in the town said.

"Many people, especially civilians, have been killed in the battle and their bodies are lying about in the streets of the town," one military source in the town said, adding that the known death toll was at least 10.
The sources said fighting began on Saturday, but had intensified on Sunday.
There is traditional rivalry between the two sides who fought together against rebels of the Revolutionary United Front but the cause of the latest fighting was not clear.
Sources said the two sides were battling with rocket propelled grenades and had each seized a part of the town.
Implementation of a November deal between president Ahmad Tejan Kabbah and rebel leader Foday Sankoh has dragged and threatens to unravel.
